Buyer guideRecords & inspection

History is one part of the picture.

Records and inspection work together

A vehicle’s past and its condition today are related, but different.

In this guide

01Use records to focus your questions02Assess the car in person03Make a decision with both
01

Use records to focus your questions

Service history, claims and ownership records can highlight what to ask about and which documents to request.

02

Assess the car in person

A qualified inspection can assess visible condition and mechanical concerns. A remote record search cannot substitute for checking the vehicle itself.

03

Make a decision with both

Consider the available history, the inspection, a test drive and the seller’s supporting documents together.

Take this question to the seller
“Can we review the history and arrange a physical inspection?”

Keep unanswered record questions available for the inspection and test drive.
